source.text:
Dear families, here is what is happening at the school this December.

The winter bake sale is on Friday, December 12.

It runs from 10:00 to 14:00 in the school gym, and all the money goes to new library books for every class.

We are looking for parents to bring cakes, cookies or bread. Please sign up at the front office by December 5, and write on the sheet if your baking contains nuts.

Class photo day moves to Tuesday, December 9, so please send your child in the school uniform.

The winter concert is on Thursday, December 18, at 15:00 in the hall. Brothers, sisters and grandparents are all welcome, and there will be tea afterwards.

School closes for the holidays on Friday, December 19, and opens again on Monday, January 5.

Thank you, as always, for everything you do for our children and our school.
